thread:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the INC-1234 postmortem — we listed alert tuning as a remediation. Can owners pick specific alerts to tune, propose thresholds, and timelines? I'll compile and drive. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-1234

Alex: I'll take the high-frequency 500/5xx spike alerts (svc-auth). Plan: increase noise dedupe window from 1m -> 5m, and change severity to 'warning' for rate spikes under 200/min. Sample rule:
```yaml
alert: SvcAuthHigh5xx
expr: sum(rate(svc_auth_http_errors_total[2m])) by (job) > 200
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: warning
```
I'll PR to monitoring-config by EOD Wed.

Tim: sounds good. For paging policy, recommend we add a `suppress_if_recent` label to mute duplicate pages from same host/service within 10m. Also we should ensure runbook links in alerts: add `runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/svc-auth-5xx`

pagerbot: alert-rate summary for svc-auth (last 24h): pages=23, unique_signals=5, duplicates=12. Top noisy sig: 5xx-transient. Next escalation: noise reduction sweep scheduled Fri 9am.

Lina: I'll own the recurring-pattern analysis across the stack. Can someone export last 90 days of alert instances (alerts, hosts, labels) and drop into /shared/alert-analytics? csv is fine. ETA Fri noon. I'll also sketch dedupe heuristics.

Alex: exported subset to /shared/alert-exports/svc-auth-90d.csv (visibility: eng). Shared PR: https://github.com/redwood/monitoring-config/pull/842

Maya: Thanks — agreed owners and timelines: Alex (svc-auth tuning) PR by Wed EOD, Lina (pattern analysis) data by Fri noon, Tim (paging suppress policy + runbook linkage) will update runbook and policy by next Tue. I'll add these to the remediation board and assign. Weekly follow-up meeting: Mon 10am. If anyone can't make it, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
